description:
Scripts in the shapes coding agents actually run: file edits, searches, JSON, loops, cleanup.

Each case is a small task as an agent would write it, so failures show up the way an agent would
meet them. Commands this shell does not have (awk, tar, ...) appear too: an agent will reach for
them, and the difference is worth seeing.

cases.name: agent: write a file with a heredoc
cases.script:
cat > /tmp/config.toml <<'EOF'
[server]
port = 8080
host = "${HOST}"
EOF
cat /tmp/config.toml

cases.name: agent: write a file with an expanding heredoc
cases.script:
name=demo; cat > /tmp/out.txt <<EOF
project: $name
files: $(echo 3)
EOF
cat /tmp/out.txt

cases.name: agent: append lines to a file
cases.script: printf 'a\n' >/tmp/f; echo b >> /tmp/f; printf '%s\n' c d >>/tmp/f; cat /tmp/f; wc -l </tmp/f

cases.name: agent: in-place sed edit
agent: in-place sed with backup
agent: sed delete and insert lines
agent: sed print a line range
cases.script: seq 1 20 >/tmp/n; sed -n '5,8p' /tmp/n; sed -n '$p' /tmp/n

cases.name: agent: replace across files
agent: rename files in a loop
cases.script: cd /tmp && touch a.txt b.txt && for f in *.txt; do mv "$f" "${f%.txt}.md"; done; ls

cases.name: agent: create a directory tree
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/app/{src,tests,docs} && touch /tmp/app/src/{a,b}.rs && find /tmp/app | sort

cases.name: agent: copy and remove trees
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/s/d && echo x >/tmp/s/d/f && cp -r /tmp/s /tmp/t && ls -R /tmp/t && rm -rf /tmp/s && ls /tmp

cases.name: agent: patch a file with diff output
cases.script:
printf 'a
b
c
' >/tmp/old; printf 'a
B
c
' >/tmp/new; diff -u /tmp/old /tmp/new >/tmp/p.diff; cp /tmp/old /tmp/work; patch /tmp/work /tmp/p.diff && cat /tmp/work

cases.name: agent: patch from stdin with strip level
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/r/src && printf 'x
' >/tmp/r/src/f && cd /tmp/r && printf -- '--- a/src/f
+++ b/src/f
@@ -1 +1 @@
-x
+y
' | patch -p1 && cat src/f

cases.name: agent: grep recursively with line numbers
agent: grep for files only
agent: grep with include and exclude
agent: grep count and quiet
agent: grep extended regex with capture via sed
agent: find files by name
agent: find and exec grep
agent: find newer and size
agent: find and delete
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/c && touch /tmp/c/a.log /tmp/c/b.log /tmp/c/keep.txt && find /tmp/c -name '*.log' -delete && ls /tmp/c

cases.name: agent: find with print0 and xargs -0
cases.script: mkdir -p '/tmp/sp' && touch '/tmp/sp/a b' /tmp/sp/c && find /tmp/sp -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -n1 echo

cases.name: agent: count lines of code
agent: word frequency
cases.script: printf 'b a c a b a\n' | tr ' ' '\n' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 2

cases.name: agent: jq select and project
agent: jq with arguments
agent: jq build JSON
cases.script: jq -n --arg name demo --argjson n 3 '{name: $name, count: $n, tags: ["x", "y"]}'

cases.name: agent: jq modify and write back
agent: jq length keys and sort
agent: jq slurp lines
cases.script: printf '{"a":1}\n{"a":2}\n' | jq -s 'map(.a) | add'

cases.name: agent: jq raw input to array
cases.script: printf 'x\ny\n' | jq -R . | jq -sc .

cases.name: agent: jq exit status
cases.script: echo '{}' | jq -e '.missing' >/dev/null; echo status=$?; echo '{"a":1}' | jq -e .a; echo status=$?

cases.name: agent: jq to CSV
agent: cut columns from CSV
agent: sort CSV by a numeric column
agent: read CSV in a loop
agent: sum a column
agent: sum a column without process substitution
agent: awk one-liner

stderr.text: bash: line 1: awk: command not found

expected.reason: ignored (missing-commands): bash-tool has no such command

cases.name: agent: normalise line endings
cases.script: printf 'a\r\nb\r\n' >/tmp/w; tr -d '\r' </tmp/w | od -c | head -n 1; sed 's/\r$//' /tmp/w | wc -c

cases.name: agent: uppercase and trim
cases.script: echo '  Hello World  ' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//'

cases.name: agent: join lines with a comma
cases.script:
printf 'a
b
c
' | paste -sd, -; printf 'a
b
' | tr '
' ',' | sed 's/,$//'; echo

cases.name: agent: dedupe preserving order
cases.script:
printf 'b
a
b
c
a
' | awk '!seen[$0]++' 2>/dev/null || printf 'b
a
b
c
a
' | cat -n | sort -uk2 | sort -n | cut -f2-

cases.name: agent: head and tail of output
cases.script: seq 1 100 | head -n 3; seq 1 100 | tail -n 2; seq 1 100 | head -n -97

cases.name: agent: number lines
cases.script:
printf 'x

y
' | nl -ba; printf 'x
y
' | cat -n

cases.name: agent: show whitespace
cases.script: printf 'a\tb \n' | cat -A

cases.name: agent: strip path components
cases.script: p=/a/b/file.tar.gz; echo "${p##*/}" "${p%/*}" "${p%%.*}" "$(basename "$p" .gz)" "$(dirname "$p")"

cases.name: agent: default and required variables
cases.script: name=${NAME:-anon}; echo $name; : "${REQUIRED:?REQUIRED must be set}" 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?

cases.name: agent: split a string into an array
cases.script: IFS=, read -ra parts <<< 'a,b,c d'; echo ${#parts[@]}; printf '[%s]' "${parts[@]}"; echo

cases.name: agent: iterate an array with indices
cases.script: arr=(x y z); for i in "${!arr[@]}"; do echo "$i=${arr[$i]}"; done

cases.name: agent: associative counter
cases.script: declare -A count; for w in a b a c a; do count[$w]=$(( ${count[$w]:-0} + 1 )); done; for k in "${!count[@]}"; do echo "$k ${count[$k]}"; done | sort

cases.name: agent: string contains and matches
cases.script: s=feature/login; [[ $s == feature/* ]] && echo branch; [[ $s =~ ^([a-z]+)/(.+)$ ]] && echo "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"; case $s in *login*) echo login;; esac

cases.name: agent: lowercase and replace
cases.script: s='Hello World'; echo "${s,,}" "${s// /_}" "${s^^}"

cases.name: agent: printf a table
cases.script: printf '%-6s|%5s\n' name size; printf '%-6s|%5d\n' a 10 bb 200

cases.name: agent: printf -v to build a string
cases.script: printf -v line '%s-%s' a b; echo "$line"

cases.name: agent: arithmetic counters
cases.script: i=0; for f in a b c; do ((i++)) || true; done; echo $i; n=$((i * 2 + 1)); echo $n

cases.name: agent: counter under set -e
cases.script: set -e; count=0; ((count++)); echo not-reached

cases.name: agent: strict mode script
cases.script:
set -euo pipefail
files=(a b)
for f in "${files[@]}"; do echo "processing $f"; done
echo done

cases.name: agent: strict mode catches an unset variable
cases.script: set -euo pipefail; echo start; echo "$undefined_var"; echo not-reached

cases.name: agent: strict mode catches a failing pipeline
cases.script: set -euo pipefail; echo start; false | cat; echo not-reached

cases.name: agent: guard with an error message
cases.script: [ -f /tmp/missing ] || { echo 'missing input' >&2; exit 3; }; echo not-reached

cases.name: agent: check a command exists
cases.script: if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo have-jq; fi; command -v nosuchtool >/dev/null || echo no-tool

cases.name: agent: cleanup trap
cases.script: tmp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"; echo cleaned' EXIT; touch "$tmp/f"; echo working

cases.name: agent: temporary file round trip
cases.script: t=$(mktemp); echo payload >"$t"; cat "$t"; rm -f "$t"; [ -e "$t" ] || echo removed

cases.name: agent: retry loop
cases.script: n=0; until [ $n -ge 3 ]; do n=$((n+1)); [ $n -eq 3 ] && { echo "ok after $n"; break; }; sleep 0.01; done

cases.name: agent: argument parsing loop
cases.script: set -- --name demo -v --count=3 rest; while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do case $1 in --name) name=$2; shift 2;; --count=*) count=${1#*=}; shift;; -v) verbose=1; shift;; *) args+=("$1"); shift;; esac; done; echo "$name $count $verbose ${args[*]}"

cases.name: agent: functions with local and return
cases.script: check() { local file=$1; [ -s "$file" ] && return 0; echo "empty: $file" >&2; return 1; }; echo x >/tmp/a; : >/tmp/b; check /tmp/a && echo a-ok; check /tmp/b; echo status=$?

cases.name: agent: function returning a value by output
cases.script: slug() { local s=${1,,}; echo "${s// /-}"; }; v=$(slug 'Hello Big World'); echo "$v"

cases.name: agent: exit codes of pipelines
cases.script: false | true; echo "${PIPESTATUS[@]}"; set -o pipefail; false | true; echo $?

cases.name: agent: conditional chains
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/x && cd /tmp/x && touch ok && ls && cd / && echo back || echo failed

cases.name: agent: while read from a file
cases.script:
printf 'one
two
three
' >/tmp/l; while IFS= read -r line; do echo "<$line>"; done </tmp/l

cases.name: agent: while read without a trailing newline
cases.script: printf 'one\ntwo' | while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do echo "<$line>"; done

cases.name: agent: readarray lines
cases.script:
printf 'a
b
c
' >/tmp/l; mapfile -t lines </tmp/l; echo ${#lines[@]} "${lines[-1]}"

cases.name: agent: parallel jobs and wait
cases.script: for i in 1 2 3; do (sleep 0.0$i; echo job$i >/tmp/j$i) & done; wait; cat /tmp/j1 /tmp/j2 /tmp/j3

cases.name: agent: background job status
cases.script: (exit 3) & pid=$!; wait $pid; echo status=$?

cases.name: agent: base64 round trip
cases.script: echo 'secret data' | base64 | tee /tmp/b64; base64 -d /tmp/b64

cases.name: agent: checksum and verify
cases.script: echo data >/tmp/f; sha256sum /tmp/f >/tmp/sums; sha256sum -c /tmp/sums; echo tampered >/tmp/f; sha256sum -c /tmp/sums; echo status=$?

cases.name: agent: hex dump
cases.script: printf 'AB\n' | od -An -tx1

cases.name: agent: human readable sizes

cases.name: agent: sequence formatting
cases.script: seq -w 8 10; seq -s, 1 5; seq 1 2 7

cases.name: agent: fixed dates

cases.name: agent: file size and existence checks
cases.script: printf 'abc' >/tmp/f; wc -c </tmp/f; stat -c %s /tmp/f; [ -s /tmp/f ] && echo nonempty; [ -d /tmp ] && echo dir

cases.name: agent: realpath and readlink
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/r/d && ln -sf /tmp/r/d /tmp/r/link && cd /tmp/r && realpath link; readlink link; readlink -f ./link/../d

stderr.text: ln: failed to create symbolic link to '/tmp/r/d': links to absolute paths are unsupported in bash-tool; use a relative target

expected.reason: fixture (symlinks): links to absolute paths are refused, since WASI cannot create them

cases.name: agent: split and reassemble
cases.script: seq 1 10 >/tmp/n; split -l 4 /tmp/n /tmp/part.; ls /tmp/part.*; cat /tmp/part.* | wc -l

cases.name: agent: compare files
cases.script:
printf 'a
b
' >/tmp/1; printf 'a
c
' >/tmp/2; cmp -s /tmp/1 /tmp/2 || echo differ; diff /tmp/1 /tmp/2; echo status=$?; comm -12 /tmp/1 /tmp/2

cases.name: agent: xargs with placeholders
cases.script:

b
' | xargs -I{} echo 'item {} done'; printf '1 2 3 4
' | xargs -n 2 echo pair

cases.name: agent: tee to a file and stdout
cases.script: echo logged | tee /tmp/log | tr a-z A-Z; cat /tmp/log

cases.name: agent: here string into a command
agent: command substitution in a condition
cases.script: if [ "$(printf 'a\nb\n' | wc -l)" -eq 2 ]; then echo two-lines; fi

cases.name: agent: nested command substitution
cases.script: echo "dir: $(basename "$(dirname /a/b/c)")"

cases.name: agent: environment for a single command
cases.script: FOO=bar env | grep '^FOO='; echo "[${FOO-}]"

cases.name: agent: export for child shells
cases.script: export API_URL=http://localhost; bash -c 'echo $API_URL'

cases.name: agent: source an env file
cases.script: printf 'export PORT=8080\nNAME="my app"\n' >/tmp/.env; set -a; . /tmp/.env; set +a; bash -c 'echo "$PORT $NAME"'

cases.name: agent: bash -c with arguments
cases.script: bash -c 'echo "$0 got $# args: $*"' runner a b

cases.name: agent: sh -c in find exec

cases.name: agent: timeout
cases.script: timeout 5 echo fast; echo status=$?

cases.script: uname -s >/dev/null; echo status=$?

cases.name: agent: tar
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/t && echo x >/tmp/t/f && tar -cf /tmp/t.tar -C /tmp t 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?

expected.reason: ignored (missing-commands): bash-tool has no such command

stderr.text:
bash: line 1: gzip: command not found
bash: line 1: gzip: command not found

cases.name: agent: expr and factor

cases.name: agent: date arithmetic

cases.name: agent: loop over command output with spaces
cases.script: printf 'a b\nc\n' >/tmp/l; while read -r l; do echo "[$l]"; done </tmp/l; for w in $(cat /tmp/l); do echo "<$w>"; done

cases.name: agent: generate files from a template
cases.script: for n in 1 2; do sed "s/NUM/$n/" <<< 'file NUM' >/tmp/f$n; done; cat /tmp/f1 /tmp/f2

cases.name: agent: check exit codes explicitly
cases.script: grep -q x /dev/null; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 1 ]; then echo no-match; elif [ $rc -gt 1 ]; then echo error; fi

cases.name: agent: write JSON with printf
cases.script: printf '{"name":"%s","n":%d}\n' demo 3 | jq -c .

cases.name: agent: escape for JSON with jq
cases.script: msg='he said "hi"'; jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{msg: $m}' -c

cases.name: agent: process substitution

cases.name: agent: stderr to a log and stdout to a pipe

cases.name: agent: silence everything
cases.script: ls /nonexistent >/dev/null 2>&1; echo status=$?; ls /nonexistent &>/dev/null; echo status=$?
